scripts.db:setup: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -X -q -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'SET client_min_messages = warning' -c 'DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE' -c 'CREATE SCHEMA public' -f sql/current-tenant.sql -f sql/schema.sql -f sql/webhook-endpoints.sql -f rate-limits.sql -c 'GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO app_user' -c 'GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user'
scripts.verify: tsc -p . && npm run --silent db:setup && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.ts
